item.title: Walk of the Week: Historic Winchester wander with Christmas Market
item.description: This Historic Winchester wander with Christmas Market is the Daily Echo's Walk of the Week with Ordnance Survey

item.title: Care home with 66 bedrooms approved despite residents' concerns
item.description: Plans for a 66-bedroom care home have been approved despite traffic concerns

item.title: Women targeted with sexual harassment messages while selling online
item.description: Officers have issued a warning after women across Fareham and Gosport have reported receiving sexually harassing messages while selling items online.

item.title: Councillor calls for splash pad to be built at Mansel Park in Millbrook
item.description: A councillor has sparked local debate after calling for a children’s splash park to be built in Millbrook, suggesting Mansel Park as a potential location.

item.title: Coastguard continues search for missing Baltic Klipper containers
item.description: Eleven of the 16 containers lost from the Baltic Klipper have now washed ashore in West Sussex as HM Coastguard continues efforts to locate the remaining units.

item.title: Where are the best and worst bathing spots in Hampshire?
item.description: Another year is almost over, and just around the corner, Boxing Day swims await. Hundreds of brave bathers across Hampshire will head to the nearest seafronts, rivers, or other bathing spots, ready for the annual chilly plunge.

item.title: The cosy tap room which fits 50 and is bringing Christmas cheer to Botley
item.description: Staff and customers are feeling festive at cosy tap room CrackleRock where nine cask ales and seven keg beers are pumped just yards from where they are brewed in Botley.

item.title: Parents face months of uncertainty as Woolston nursery sets 2026 reopening date
item.description: YMCA Woolston Nursery is expected to remain closed until spring 2026.

item.title: Increase in council house evictions as authority takes action on rent arrears
item.description: Council housing tenant evictions in Southampton have increased as the local authority attempts to take action on rent arrears.

item.title: From Peter Pan to Puss in Boots - all the areas best pantos and Christmas shows
item.description: There's everything from Peter Pan to Puss in Boots bringing festive joy to audiences in the area from now on.
